scope: R22 original-game UI integration preview, isolated in-memory equipment account, no enemy waves, real terrain and real loot; no formal production integration or performance acceptance

build.entry: Native production boot / World / BattleRenderer / HUD / menu / intermission, no enemies, real drops, isolated in-memory account
build.delta: Only two renderer context-loss calls added by parallel shared-render work: adaptiveTimer.clear() and adaptive.suspend(). UI runtime, CSS, assets and other code exact. New context-restore/resume/reopen test uses this final build.

typecheck.note: Current shared source at this check; later parallel edits are not silently relabeled.

checks: Original homepage replaces talent entry; direct loadout, warehouse and forge return correctly; three race art and uniform 64px visible framing verified
Native deployment and resource gate enter a real terrain / WebGL scene with six actual equipment drops and zero enemies; original minimap talent slot becomes backpack
Native keyboard movement picks up; backpack freezes native clock and movement; one-click drop retains identity; re-pickup and confirmed destruction pay no dust

Backpack embeds in original intermission; real attribute swap and dismantle pay correct inventory changes, polluted/module equip remains blocked, native service tabs and return release equipment window
Original game display settings change embedded equipment text; 320/390 portrait and 844 landscape layouts stay bounded; Escape returns to original intermission
core.failureReason: Last harness step attempted the minimap bag while the native restored pause screen was still open. Core UI checks and original next-stage transition had passed. This failure remains unchanged.

checks: Final delivered bundle hash is exact; native settings choose adaptive; real map remains enemy-free; actual WebGL loss closes the bag and preserves equipment; native recovery remains paused; native Continue resumes, backpack reopens and returns safely.

reuseProof.note: 19 earlier captures retain their actual build. Only two context-loss timer reset statements changed; all UI/CSS and pre-loss paths exact. The affected loss/restore/continue/reopen path was repeated on the final bundle.

visualReview.result: Original menu and native map visible, original minimap slot reused, original intermission retained, comparison rows corrected, narrow layouts bounded and scrollable. No user or physical-device acceptance claimed.

preservation.note: Static preview stays bound to its built bytes. Later unit-material-batch edits from the parallel renderer work remain in shared source and are not swept into this preview or claimed as tested by this report.
